title: The Law That Applies to Everyone

collection.credit:
ISOLA — BEYOND THE HORIZON: THE WORLD WE IMAGINE
A NEW, SEPARATE COMPANION EVENT ANTHOLOGY FOR VIRTUAL VILLAGERS 1–5
Version 1.0 | 40 original branching events
collection.description: After a respected craftsperson breaks a village rule, a child asks whether powerful people obey their own laws.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: After a respected craftsperson breaks a village rule, a child asks whether distant societies expect powerful people to obey their own laws.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The council reviews whether its own rules apply fairly to friends and strangers.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: A skeptic asks whether rules written equally can still affect people unequally.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: Researchers devise a hypothetical system of witnesses, appeals, and independent judges.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A villager worries that a complicated system could be inaccessible to poor or illiterate people.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The child argues that context and repair can matter alongside punishment.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: Someone harmed by the original act insists that mercy must not erase accountability.
